{# One walk over the area data fills the breadcrumb, the sidebar and the pager, so the switch, the trail and the previous/next links can never disagree. It sits above because carries the active area as an attribute. Trailing slashes are trimmed on both sides: `get_url(path='/')` returns the bare base URL while `current_url` for the same page carries the slash, and the home page would otherwise match nothing. Tera cannot compare a function call directly, so every URL is bound to a variable first. A break out of the area loop stops the pager crossing from the last page of one area into the first page of the next, and `nav_last` resets per area so the first page of an area has no Previous. One path may appear twice (a hub item that is also its own first child), so both the match and the Next assignment ignore a repeat. An item's children are visited right after the item, so reading order is depth first. The child body repeats the item body because a Tera macro cannot `set_global` into its caller. #} {%- set here = current_url | default(value="") | trim_end(pat="/") -%} {%- set home =
